email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGluca patient with sudden difficulty breathing and facial swelling
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a clinical care coordinator at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 60-year-old male patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their first dose of DemoGluca (dose: 5mg) via oral.
Treatment started on 2026-03-12.
Approximately 6 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed sudden difficulty breathing and facial swelling.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Petrov (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
Contact: demo.reporter792@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
